title: Camp O-AT-KA
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Founded in 1906, is a traditional camp for boys located on the sandy shores of Sebago Lake in Southern Maine. With safety being a main priority, boys come to O-AT-KA to explore new interests and gain skills in their crafts. As O-AT-KA evolves throughout history, the mission of building boys into self-assured men of character and virtue remains steadfast.
